pr_title: [example/glue] fix compute_metrics_fn for bart like models
pr_comments: Merged too fast, commited @sgugger's suggestion here: aae4edb

issue_context.title: [example/glue] run_glue compute metrics fail for bart like models
issue_context.body:
This PR #7126 introduced multiple predictions for trainer. This breaks the `compute_metrics_fn` of `run_glue.py`  for `bart` like models which return multiple predictions.

For `BartForSequenceClassfication` `p.predictions`  is a `tuple`, so following code fails
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/1d90d0f386af2af52017d51c421e71a51ec94de0/examples/text-classification/run_glue.py#L154

@sgugger
comments: I didn't expect that side effect, thanks for fixing it so quickly!

review_comments:
```suggestion
            preds = p.predictions[0] if isinstance(p.predictions, tuple) else p.predictions
```
(More pythonic since it will catch the subclasses too.)
